brief:
Displaced Palestinians in the West Bank face worsening hunger after the World Food Programme halved its food assistance, Al Jazeera English reported. The cuts come as thousands already struggle after losing homes to Israeli military operations.

The reduction compounds existing hardship for displaced families with limited access to income and resources. The WFP's decision to reduce aid leaves vulnerable populations with fewer options to meet basic nutritional needs.
dek: Already struggling after losing homes to Israeli military operations, Palestinians face hardship as WFP halves aid.
title: UN cuts food aid to displaced West Bank Palestinians
